quotes.author: merlynm1028
quotes.text: I surprised my fiance for his bday signing up with Sail with Scott and he absolutely loved it, we both loved it! It was such an amazing, romantic, and relaxing experiencing disconnecting from technology and all other distractions and just enjoying each other's company and appreciating nature. The staff on the boat were super friendly, welcoming, and fun! They did their part to keep safety precautions in place and everyone obliged. They play a good variety of music that definitely sets the mood and makes the sailing experience even more beautiful! This is definitely a great date night idea, and will totally recommend! :D

quotes.author: mca10spro
quotes.text: Sail with Scott was a very relaxing experience. I did the sunset trip. The boat was cleaned prior to our trip and the captain is very Covid conscious. I felt comfortable with the cleanliness of the boat. The 90 minutes boat ride was relaxing with a great song playlist to accompany the ride. There’s a photo opportunity about halfway out. The captain also blows a conch shell at sunset to add a nice touch to the ride. It was very relaxing and well organized.

quotes.author: Pedro V
quotes.text: Crew was extremely nice and friendly! It was a nice ride through the Harbor and even though it was hot by the time we boarded, as evening came along, the weather felt better and there was a full moon to make the ride even better. Highly recommended! Just take your own drinks and food (if you need to). The crew will give you a complimentary bottle of water.

quotes.author: Cricket. j
quotes.text: The night weather was perfect! My husband and I sailed the 6:00-7:30 sail. I would highly recommend. You are allowed to bring a small ice chest with food and eat on one of the tables, along with your choice of beverage. They do offer water and there is a Restroom below. I would highly recommend, as the price is reasonably appropriate for the view.

quotes.author: safyrespitfire
quotes.text: The team on Sail with Scott were fantastic. We sailed on a Friday evening fireworks cruise for my husband's birthday. Everyone had a great time. We will definitely come back again.

quotes.author: Alibri67
quotes.text: What a great evening! Kind courteous staff who helped me out of a dilemma when I’d accidentally booked for 3 instead of 4! Great photo ops, music and atmosphere.
